g.text: Where this fits: System 2 asks, System 1 checks
an LLM agent or a fixed
• which of A, B, C is true?
"System Two organizes the decision space, while System One evaluates it against visual evidence."
Applications named: procedural monitoring, interactive assistance, embodied agents, computer use. Next steps: more
task types (action recognition, event detection), streaming input, better calibration.
